purpose: Precommitted account-local prediction and outcome learning without mutation of scientific evidence.
rules: Prediction must exist before an outcome can be evaluated.
Expected and falsification conditions may not require the same metric to have the same state.
Outcome evaluation is account-local operational evidence only.
No outcome record may mutate scientific node/edge lifecycle or evidence status.
Inconclusive outcomes remain explicit rather than being forced into support/falsification.
Metric-state labels require account/context calibration; this layer defines no universal thresholds.
